# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Please update to the newest version from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/duhs0011/MacPhoneInput/releases/latest) before reporting an issue.

| Version | Supported |
| ------- | --------- |
| Latest release | :white_check_mark: |
| Older releases | :x: |

## Reporting Vulnerabilities

You may report low-severity security vulnerabilities through GitHub issues. 

For critical security issues, please report them via GitHub's [vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/duhs0011/MacPhoneInput/security/advisories/new).

1. Open the [Security tab](https://github.com/duhs0011/MacPhoneInput/security) of this repository.
2. Select **Report a vulnerability**.
3. Describe the issue.

To help triage, please include as much as you can:

- Affected version, Mac model, macOS version, iPhone model, and iOS version
- The vulnerability and its impact
- Steps to reproduce or a proof of concept
- Any suggested mitigation

We aim to acknowledge reports promptly and will coordinate a fix and disclosure with you. Please allow reasonable time to address the issue.
